scope: For AC1024 with maintenance version greater than 3 and AC1032, account for the additional high-size RL when locating the CLASSES RS. Do not infer class-body or document support from the integrity correction.

specEvidence.authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 10.2 R18+ (PDF page 87)
relevantRules: The R2010+ maintenance-version-greater-than-3 class header includes an additional RL after the low size RL.
The class data follows the header and the RS CRC follows the class records.
With the optional RL, the class-data prefix grows from 20 to 24 bytes in the decoded section coordinates used by this parser.
specEvidence.crossCheck: The parser's string footer uses the same 20/24-byte prefix as 159/191 bits before the end-bit position. Rounding that footer endpoint to a byte yields the class-data size plus the matching prefix.

implementation.change: Compute the optional high-size-RL predicate once and use a 24-byte CRC prefix when present; retain the 20-byte prefix otherwise.
